newsitem.title: USA: Williams eyes acquisitions, joint ventures.
newsitem.headline: Williams eyes acquisitions, joint ventures.

text.p: Williams Cos is eyeing acquisitions and possible joint ventures with U.S. electric utilities as it seeks to boost earnings, Chairman Keith Bailey said on Monday.
"We do need to make strategic acquisitions in the energy business," Bailey said during a presentation at the Howard Weil energy conference in New Orleans.

Bailey said the company was also in talks on joint ventures with electric utilities similar to its partnership with Boston Edison Co to provide consumers with "one-stop" shopping for natural gas, electricity and other energy needs.
"We would like to do similar things in other regions of the country, and we do have discussions under way to accomplish that," he said.
He said the company also must close accretive acquisitions to boost annual earnings into the upper range of analysts' estimates of $2.27 to $2.57 a share.

Fueled by deregulation of the electric utility industry, traditional pipeline companies such as Williams are eyeing options for competing in the emerging energy industry on both the wholesale and retail levels.
